messages:
ajay: quick sync — i'm putting together a small shim to emit two new runtime signals for canaries: `quota_headroom_pct` and `per_shard_gpu_util`.
maria: nice. can you clarify how quota_headroom_pct is computed? is it per-customer quota or per-route global? :thinking_face:
ajay: plan is per-route + global fallback. formula: (remaining_quota_tokens / quota_window_tokens) * 100. emits every 10s.
sasha: short question — do we want absolute token headroom or normalized vs expected traffic? some routes have bursty spikes.
ajay: good call. we'll include `expected_rate` as an optional field from routing layer so dashboard panels can show both raw headroom and headroom_vs_expected.
kevin: what about cardinality? per-route+per-customer sounds high. we should reserve detailed customer breakdown for Dedicated customers only.
ajay: yep — default emit is route-level only. customer-level tag emitted when tenant_id != null AND tenant_has_dedicated flag.
ellie: for the compare dashboard i want a delta panel that shows canary vs control for p50/p95 latency, error_rate, quota_headroom_pct, and gpu_util — side-by-side time series with a single diff overlay.
kevin: +1 on overlay. also add a small heatmap for per_shard_gpu_util to catch noisy imbalance.
ajay: implementation note: runtime will push these signals to telemetry-proxy with tags: {route, model_variant, region, canary_id, shard_id?}. sample payload below:
```
{
  "metric": "quota_headroom_pct",
  "value": 36.2,
  "tags": {"route":"/v1/generate","model":"redwood-qa/13b","region":"us-west-2","canary_id":"c-2026-03-20-01"}
}
```

sasha: recommend adding `rollout_phase` tag (canary/control/primary) so dashboards can auto-group.
ajay: done — will include rollout_phase.
ellie: what alerting thresholds should we expose? we should avoid noisy alerts during warmup. maybe use a short warmup window (5m) and require sustained delta > X for alert.
maria: agree. propose alert if canary p95 > control p95 by 20% for 10m AND quota_headroom_pct delta < -15 for 10m.
kevin: also consider rate of change alerts for gpu_util imbalance: if shard_stddev(util) increases by > 0.15 in 2m.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: telemetry-proxy -> staging at 1857654360 by ajay
ajay: i'll push a canary once the proxy is up. tagging docs in the dashboard repo with signal contract and example panels.
sasha: can we get a small example grafana json? ellie can help with panels.
ellie: i'll sketch a compare dashboard and wire up a templated variable for `canary_id`. will add the diff overlay and heatmap.
maria: ping me when dashboard PR is ready, i'll check compliance with billing telemetry (we can't accidentally expose tenant tokens)
ajay: noted — metrics will be aggregated and tagged, no tenant secrets. customer_id tags only for Dedicated and will be hashed.
kevin: timeline? i'd like staging canary by EOD tomorrow if possible.
ajay: aiming for tomorrow EOD. will follow up with a short README and the telemetry contract file in infra/telemetry/contracts.
sasha: thank you — looks clean. after staging validation we should run a small 5% traffic A/B for 2 hours and evaluate the delta dashboard.
ellie: i'll add a checklist for dashboard validation and a simple runbook for rollback if alert fires.
maria: awesome. thanks team. :rocket:
